items.title: "Marina" Dares You to Laugh at Technology
items.summary: Julio Torres and Martine Gutierrez's new performance is a grotesque parade of visual delights that defangs our toxic relationship to our screens.

items.title: Jennifer Higgie’s Empathetic Elegy for Richard Dadd
items.summary: In “Bedlam,” the author and art critic does not describe the English painter’s often-sensationalized mental deterioration. Instead, she writes the novel in his voice.
